d.s: SikaRoof VersiCell Flex is a lightweight, high strength drainage module manufactured from re cycled polypropylene (PP) with cells 30 mm high, providing large internal void volumes for increased drainage discharge capacity. The module is flexible to accommodate curvatures of structural designs. SikaRoof VersiCell Flex forms a hollow space between the structural element and the planting media, providing excellent drainage to prevent flooding of the landscape features.
a: Flexible to conform with structural design
Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Operates within a wide service temperature range
Interlocking modular design ensuring continuous drainage
Small surface perforations to prevent sagging of geotextile
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
us: Drainage layer for intensive green roofs, podium landscapes and planter boxes in combination with a suitable geotextile as a filtration layer to prevent planting media from clogging the drainage layer

sec.t: No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance to the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet

Bundles must be stored in their original packing, laid in a horizontal position, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice and any other elements.
